parole.testo: Borrowed from taxonomic name Argonauta, which, like Argonaut (“legendary Greek sailor on the Argo”) is taken from Ancient Greek Ἀργοναύτης (Argonaútēs).

parole.significato: bone of contention, point of contention (cause of controversy or division)
parole.testo: Compound of splijten (“to split, to divide”) + zwam (“fungus, mushroom”). Calque of taxonomic name Schizomycetes. Ultimately from Ancient Greek σχίζω (skhízō, “I split”) + plural form of μύκης (múkēs, “mushroom, fungus, mushroom-shaped objects”). Refers to bacteria's habit of multiplying by splittin
